title: Develop and manage infrastructure resource planning
goal: The venture knows what it runs on, how much headroom each part has, what would have to change if use doubled, and what its licences and seats will cost over the next year.

steps.do: Write in a paragraph how the venture intends to run its systems over the next year, hosted and managed, self-run, or a mix, and the reason it is the right shape for a venture of this size and stage.

Read the venture's goals and write what the infrastructure has to be able to do for them: the load it must take, how much downtime is tolerable, how fast a recovery has to be, and where data must sit.
List what the venture runs on today, the hosts, databases, queues, storage and the plan each is on, with its present use against its limit, and record the headroom and the limit on each connection.

Say for each part what would have to change if use doubled or the venture signed its largest plausible customer, what it would cost and how long it would take, and bring each change that costs money or accepts new terms to the founder.

Count the seats and licences the venture holds against the people and agent roles that actually use them, project what the next year costs at the venture's expected size, and propose dropping the seats nobody opened.
Add the headroom figures and the projected cost as evidence to the decision they bear on, and raise to the product lead which limit the venture will hit first and what to do about it.

done_criteria.check: Does every part the venture runs on name its present use against its limit, is the limit the venture will hit first named with its date, and is every seat nobody used open as a decision for the founder?
